inferred_creative_thinking.insight: The single most dreaded part of buying jeonse deposit-guarantee insurance is not the price but assembling a pile of government certificates (residence record, certified lease, deposit receipt, occupant confirmations) from multiple agencies — a chore renters openly hate.
inferred_creative_thinking.persona: A late-20s to 30s Korean tenant on a jeonse lease who wants to protect a large deposit but is intimidated by the bureaucratic document gauntlet and would rather do everything inside one trusted app.
inferred_creative_thinking.moment: The instant of dread when you realize enrolling means a scavenger hunt for paperwork — reframed into relief when Toss issues the required certificates for you inside the same flow.
inferred_creative_thinking.product_role: Toss collapses the whole enrollment AND the certificate-issuance errand into one in-app journey: pick the product, enter property/contract info, see an estimated premium, issue documents directly in Toss, attach, submit, pay — done.
inferred_creative_thinking.punchline: The paperwork that used to make you scream is now a few taps inside Toss, with a discount and points on top.
inferred_creative_thinking.differentiator: Unlike a generic insurance signup, Toss cross-pollinates its own certificate-issuance utility into the guarantee-insurance flow, removing the offline document-gathering friction entirely.
inferred_creative_thinking.brand_fit_one_liner: Toss earns trust by quietly deleting the most annoying step of a stressful financial task, not by talking about money.

inferred_brief: Create a ~60-second vertical creator-style explainer that dramatizes the paperwork pain of enrolling in jeonse deposit-guarantee insurance, then walks step-by-step through doing it entirely inside Toss — selecting 전세보증금 반환보증, entering property and contract details, viewing the estimated premium, issuing the required certificates directly in Toss, submitting for review, and paying — closing with a 3% premium discount and 15,000 Toss-point incentive.
